# HSO — High School Opportunity

> HSO is a curated discovery platform that helps U.S. high school students find internships, research programs, scholarships, competitions, summer programs, and fellowships from universities, nonprofits, and companies.

HSO is editorial: every program links to its official page, with eligibility, deadlines, cost, and format reviewed by editors. Browsing is free; accounts are only used to save favorites and curated collections.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and filter the full HSO catalog of opportunities.
- [About](/about): What HSO is, who it's for, and how listings are reviewed.
- [Collections](/collections): Curated collections of opportunities by major, career, and interest.
- [Submit an opportunity](/submit): Suggest a program for the HSO catalog.
- [Contact & corrections](/contact): Report outdated deadlines, broken links, or missing programs.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How HSO handles accounts and saved data.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use for the HSO directory.

## Guides

- [Best medical internships](/guides/top-medical-internships): Medical internships and hospital research for high schoolers.
- [Best research competitions](/guides/top-research-competitions): Research competitions for high school students.
- [Best business summer programs](/guides/top-business-summer-programs): Business and entrepreneurship summer programs.
- [High school law internships](/guides/high-school-law-internships): Law internships and legal shadowing for teens.

## Categories

- [Summer programs](/categories/summer-programs): Summer programs for high school students.
- [Internships](/categories/internships): High school internships across industries.
- [Scholarships](/categories/scholarships): Scholarships open to high school students.
- [Research](/categories/research): High school research programs.
- [Competitions](/categories/competitions): Academic and STEM competitions for teens.
- [Fellowships](/categories/fellowships): Fellowships for high schoolers.
- [Remote & nationwide](/remote): Online and nationwide programs open to students in any U.S. state.
